authorization: Require organization_id resolved through active membership and dataset:read scope; database RLS remains authoritative. Inaccessible records return 404.
filters: List supports product_id, SHA-256 digest, UUID cursor and limit 1-100. The optional project_id filter requires active project membership and returns only snapshots with a current grant to that project.
disclosure: List/detail return metadata summaries; manifest returns source provenance. These routes do not authorize or serve raw bytes.
readiness: Scientific status remains not_validated. G03 and production readiness are not asserted.
